native_build_requirement.reason: the scratch estimator is a runtime change; the existing source175 executable and metallib predate it

native_variants.name: default_native

native_variants.environment_contract: Run with the root runner’s sanitized environment; do not inherit NM_CONTACT_* or NM_FEM_* selectors unless the separate protocol explicitly requires them.

native_variants.name: compensated_native
native_variants.note: Checker parser supports the arithmetic flag; it does not enable --accurate-paper or alter tolerances.
native_variants.precondition: verify source manifest, executable and metallib hashes from fresh overlay build metadata; root owns serialized GPU dispatch

checks_not_covered: The 17-check CPU target covers modeled allocation arithmetic only; it performs zero physics transactions.

A successful old source175 scan run is not a build or native execution of overlay 176-002.
